templates.name: Template Andy Runtime Network - MikroTik SNMPv3
templates.description: Read-only OSI network telemetry. Host-local endpoints and parent mapping; no application checks. L1 suppression is gated on verified topology.

items.name: NETWORK HEALTH: L1 PHYSICAL
items.params: (nodata(//andy.parent.oper,90s)=0 and nodata(//andy.parent.admin,90s)=0 and nodata(//andy.topology.evidence,1h)=0 and last(//andy.topology.consistent)=1)*(1+2*(last(//andy.parent.oper)<>1 or last(//andy.parent.admin)<>1)+(last(//andy.parent.oper)=1 and last(//andy.parent.admin)=1 and (last(//andy.parent.rx_errors)>0 or last(//andy.parent.tx_errors)>0 or last(//andy.parent.rx_discards)>0 or last(//andy.parent.tx_discards)>0)))

items.name: NETWORK HEALTH: L2 DATA LINK
items.params: (count(count_foreach(//andy.domain.oper[*],90s),"gt",0)=8 and count(count_foreach(//andy.domain.arp[*],90s),"gt",0)=8 and count(last_foreach(//andy.domain.arp[*]),"eq",0)=0 and nodata(//andy.topology.evidence,1h)=0)*(1+(last(//andy.summary.domains)<>8 or last(//andy.topology.consistent)=0 or last(//andy.summary.complete)<>8 or count(last_foreach(//andy.domain.oper[*]),"eq",1)<>8)+(last(//andy.summary.domains)<>8 or count(last_foreach(//andy.domain.oper[*]),"eq",1)<>8))
